title: assure record
description: Reads the suites' output, the state of the tree, and the spec from the git objects of the commit checked out, and writes the proof run predicate outside the checkout for the provider's attestation action. Exits non-zero and writes nothing on an unknown or malformed test ID, a commit that is not the full commit checked out, a tree with uncommitted changes (also changes that git status hides), or a job whose workflow is not the trusted signer. With go run -C cmd/assure, a relative path in a flag is read from cmd/assure, not from the root of the checkout: give each path absolute.

title: assure gate change
description: Gates the change against the base head in the checkout that holds the working folder, reading both commits from git objects; the Lathe CLI is node_modules/.bin/lathe of the checkout unless --lathe names another, and the gate job names the Lathe it builds. Reads the trusted signer, the change ref (GITHUB_REF), the API and the token from the job environment, prints the decision with every reason and appends it to the step summary. Exits 0 when the change passes, 1 when it is refused, and 2, with no decision, when called wrongly or when it cannot decide, such as when Lathe finds an error in the spec at either commit; on exit 2 it writes one line to the step summary that says no decision was reached and why. With go run -C cmd/assure, a relative path in a flag is read from cmd/assure, not from the root of the checkout: give each path absolute.

title: assure gate release
description: Gates the release commit in the checkout that holds the working folder, reading it from git objects; the Lathe CLI is node_modules/.bin/lathe of the checkout unless --lathe names another, and the gate-release job names the Lathe it builds. Before it gates, it refuses a step summary or a predicate path inside the checkout, and a file already at the predicate path, which it does not remove, so a run writes no predicate but its own. Reads the trusted signer, the job's own workflow identity, the API and the token from the job environment, prints the decision with every reason and appends it to the step summary; after a refused decision it prints one notice line for the CI log, ::notice::release refused: N reasons, and the gate-release job ends green, for a refused release is a neutral outcome. It then writes the decision predicate outside the checkout, for the attest-release job to sign, only when the release passes. Exits 0 when the release passes, 1 when it is refused, and 2, with no predicate, when called wrongly, when its output is refused, or when it cannot decide, such as when Lathe finds an error in the spec at the commit or the job is not the trusted workflow at main. On exit 2 it writes one line to the step summary, when the summary is outside the checkout, that says no decision was reached and why; when the predicate of a passed decision cannot be written, that line follows the decision. With go run -C cmd/assure, a relative path in a flag is read from cmd/assure, not from the root of the checkout: give each path absolute.

title: stego deps
description: stego deps resolves the service's modules and writes go.mod and go.sum.

title: stego build download
description: stego build download writes a module cache for one revision.

title: stego build
description: stego build builds and records the executable. It takes the SDK as a flag today, not from the archetype.

title: stego image build
description: stego image build builds the image.

title: stego image publish
description: stego image publish pushes the image and reads it back.

title: stego init
description: stego init -archetype <name> scaffolds a declaration in the current folder.

description: Not written yet.

description: Not written yet.

title: qualify-compiler-release.py
description: A release script, not a stego command. It qualifies one commit and writes its qualification record into the result folder.

title: qualify-compiler-release.py --verify-release
description: A release script, not a stego command. It verifies the published release as a consumer installs it.

title: install-compiler.py
description: An installation script, not a stego command. It installs one verified release on Linux amd64.

title: stego delivery check
description: stego delivery check runs every STEGO check on a CI-built image, as the last step of each provider's pipeline. Planned.

title: stego fill create
description: stego fill create scaffolds a fill and its test for one slot and collection.

title: stego test
description: stego test runs the fills' tests. It records no evidence yet.

title: stego fill sign
description: Not written yet: stego fill sign will sign a fill's evidence with the person's key.

title: stego apply
description: stego apply plans and applies, and prints the plan. It has no flag to allow a hand edit, no flag to override a pin that does not stand, cannot read a saved plan, and writes no architecture view yet.

title: stego recover
description: stego recover takes no arguments and completes an interrupted apply.

title: stego plan
description: stego plan makes a plan and prints the action for each generated file. Today it saves nothing, so apply plans again.

title: stego assets
description: stego assets captures a frontend build as a checked asset bundle.

title: stego fix
description: Not written yet: stego fix rewrites the declaration to the next declaration version the registry accepts and prints each construct it cannot rewrite, with its path; with --dry-run it prints the rewrite and writes nothing.

title: stego registry promote
description: Not written yet: stego registry promote will copy a component from the local registry into a checkout of the common registry, at stage alpha, for review.
